description: YHRepair-2516 is a ready to use, quick-setting, portland-cement-based hydraulic repair mortar that instantly stops running water through holes or cracks in concrete or masonry.
whereToUse: It is ideal to repair non-moving (static) cracks and holes with running water or moisture seepage
underground utility tunnels, basements, retaining walls, water supply pipelines, dams, and equipment foundations
sealing internal corners of walls and floors, as well as areas around pipe penetrations, prior to applying waterproof materials in kitchens and bathrooms
It can also be used for exterior wall waterproofing
advantages: Fast setting speed, so it can stop running water and develop high strength quickly
Fully hydraulic so it can be set above or below the water
mixing: Mix the material at a powder-to-water ratio of 1:(0.27-0.4).
